profile_text.body:
Monitaur is a software company focused on AI governance, describing itself as providing "actionable governance for the entire lifecycle of your AI." Its platform is aimed at enterprises, particularly in financial services and insurance, and is designed to help organizations establish company-wide standards and controls, monitor model performance continuously, and validate AI models with consistent protocols and transparent reporting. The company positions its software as enabling responsible and compliant AI adoption while also supporting rapid development.

The core product, also called Monitaur, is categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform that combines model monitoring with built-in governance capabilities. Use cases highlighted on the company's site include unifying policies across underwriting, claims, and risk models, governing third-party AI projects, and helping a described Fortune 200 company in financial services deploy AI while meeting regulatory requirements. The company notes a placement in Gartner's inaugural Magic Quadrant for AI Governance as a Visionary.

The held facts confirm Monitaur maintains an active profile on theworldofai.org with one tracked product. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are noted in the available data.
